_why: Raises the derived floor. The pass path IS the 48 V bus: vin_raw and vout land on a board HV class and derive 0.25 on their own, but the cell's INTERNAL copper (vin, VS, GATE) sits at the same potential under module-local net names, which every board puts on its Default class. Only the schematic knows that, so the whole cell is held at the HV floor.
